description: Purpose: anchored spread between rCB and native carbon black - anchoring ratio rho, discount rate and price gap per grade/region/period; the quantitative 'how much cheaper is rCB' indicator. Guidelines: pass date (YYYY-MM), region (CN/EU/NA/SEA), grade (P1/P2/P3); pair with get_grade_trend for direction and calculate_saving for custom quotes. Limits: N550-anchored reference range, not transaction price; single-period snapshot, no forecast. Ex: 'rCB vs N550 discount CN 2026-09'.
name: get_rcb_vcb_spread

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).

title: rCB vs VCB Spread
